'''Erith daughter of [[Iva]] daughter of [[Alar]]''' is an [[Ogier]] from [[Stedding Tsofu|''Stedding'' Tsofu]].

== Appearance ==
She is small for an Ogier, standing about 8 feet tall, with a straight mouth and a short and well rounded nose. Her features are more delicate than Loial's. Her eyes are the color of a silverbell's ripe seedpod. She has glossy dark hair down to her back. Her ears are curving and plump tipped with fine tufts.{{ref/book|11|19}} Her voice sounds like the "softer rumble of a smaller bumblebee" in comparison with Loial's deeper voice.{{ref/book|2|35}}

== Activities ==
=== Meeting Loial ===
Erith first met [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Loial]] as they were pursuing [[Padan Fain]] and the [[Horn of Valere]].{{ref/book|2|35}} There was apparently a mutual attraction between Loial and Erith; before Rand's party left the ''[[stedding]]'', Erith gave Loial a flower, which he pressed inside one of his books. Loial confided in his human friends that he thought Erith was "very pretty."

Later on, Loial rambled about Erith's beauty to Perrin to the point that he was worried about being seen as "coarse"{{ref/book|6|54}} and claimed to tell everyone he met about how carefully she listened to his explanation about some subject.{{ref/book|10|24}} Erith praised Loial's bravery{{ref/book|6|20}} and heroism.{{ref/book|11|19}}

=== The chase ===
Erith later joined Elder [[Haman]] and [[Covril|Loial's mother]] on a journey to find Loial, who, in their opinion, had been away from [[Stedding Shangtai|''Stedding'' Shangtai]] too long; his mother had plans to marry him off to Erith.{{ref/book|6|20}} The three Ogier Traveled with Rand to [[Shadar Logoth]] so Rand could seal the [[Waygate]] there, and then Traveled to the [[Two Rivers]] and [[Emond's Field]], where Rand last knew Loial to be located.{{ref/book|6|21}}

They finally caught up with Loial at Lord [[Algarin|Algarin's]] manor house in [[Tear]],{{ref/book|11|18}} where Erith and Loial were wed by Elder Haman in a brief ceremony.{{ref/book|11|19}} Erith quickly asserted her authority as Loial's wife over his mother to support him in speaking at the [[Great Stump]] in favor of helping the humans at the [[Last Battle]]. Then they set off with Loial's mother for ''Stedding'' Shangtai, where Loial is to address the [[Great Stump]].{{ref/book|11|20}}

=== The Last Battle ===
After the conclusion of the Great Stump, Erith traveled to the [[Field of Merrilor]] along with the rest of the Ogier.{{ref/book|14|7}} She fought alongside Loial as part of [[Elayne Trakand|Elayne Trakand's]] army in the Last Battle.{{ref/book|14|16}}
